title: Demolition Derby community event

facts.statement: A Demolition Derby community event ran at the Thunder Falls (Torrentrueno) track on Server 1, on Thursday 18 November 2010 at 15:00 Pacific Time for USA and Latin America.
facts.quote: Jueves 18 de noviembre del 2010 15:00 Tiempo Pacifico (USA y Latino America) Servidor 1

facts.statement: The same Demolition Derby event was scheduled for Friday 19 November 2010 at 09:00 Pacific Time (16:00 GMT) for UK and Europe, on Server 1.
facts.quote: Viernes 19 de noviembre del 2010 09:00 hrs. Tiempo Pacifico/16:00 hrs. GMT (UK y Europa) Servidor 1

facts.statement: A Demolition Derby community event ran at the Thunder Falls track on Server 1, scheduled for 18 Nov 2010 at 15:00 Pacific (USA and Latin America) and 19 Nov 2010 at 09:00 Pacific / 16:00 GMT (UK and Europe).
facts.quote: Jueves 18 de noviembre del 2010 15:00 Tiempo Pacifico

article_summaries.title: Evento Comunitario: Día de Demolición en el Derbi
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language community event page announcing a Demolition Derby kart-smashing event at the Thunder Falls (Torrentrueno) racetrack on Server 1, held 18 November 2010 (US/Latin America) and 19 November 2010 (UK/Europe). It explains how to learn kart derby driving from David Destrozos and how to find community events through the in-game Game Guide calendar. The article's posting date is only given relative to capture ('6 months, 2 weeks ago'), so it is left null.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New? (Community Event: Demolition Derby at the Derby, Spanish-language post)
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language Free Realms news post announcing a Demolition Derby community event at the Thunder Falls kart racing track, held on Server 1 on 18 November 2010 (USA/Latin America) and 19 November 2010 (UK/Europe). It explains that players learn kart derby driving from David Destrozos (the trainer NPC) and find matches through the Test Derby Zone, and that events are reached via the in-game Game Guide calendar.
